Event.description: The Event JSON Schema is structured to represent meetings or calendar events, capturing key information required for scheduling and managing these interactions.

Attachments.description: A list of file attachments included in the calendar event.

items.description: Attachments should be placed in the folder "files".

Body.description: The agenda or description of the meeting. This field includes details on what the meeting will cover.

Category.description: A categorization label for the meeting, such as 'Green Category'. This can be used for filtering or organizing meetings. Cannot contain commas or semicolons.

StartDateTime.description: The start date and time of the meeting. Follows ISO 8601 format ({date}T{time}), e.g., '2017-08-29T04:00:00' or '2017-08-29T04:00:00.0000000'. If ending with 'Z', TimeZone must be 'UTC'.

EndDateTime.description: The end date and time of the meeting. Follows ISO 8601 format ({date}T{time}), e.g., '2017-08-29T04:00:00' or '2017-08-29T04:00:00.0000000'. If ending with 'Z', TimeZone must be 'UTC'.

EventId.description: An identifier for each calendar event, useful for tracking and reference.

Locations.description: The physical or virtual locations of the meeting.

LocationsV2.description: The physical or virtual locations of the meeting.

displayName.description: The name associated with the location.

locationEmailAddress.description: Optional email address of the location.

uniqueId.description: The unique id of the specified room.

uniqueIdType.description: The unique id type of the specified room.

address.description: The street address of the location.

countryOrRegion.description: The country or region. It's a free-format string, for example, 'United States'.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of the location.

accuracy.description: Accuracy of the latitude and longitude in meters.

altitudeAccuracy.description: Accuracy of the altitude in meters.

OptionalAttendees.description: A list of optional participants in the meeting.

Recurrence.description: Indicates whether the meeting is recurrent and how the reccurence should be.

RequiredAttendees.description: A list of required participants in the meeting.

Sender.description: The MailNickName of the person who organized the meeting, e.g., 'robertscott'. Must not contain '@' (use only the prefix, not a full email address).

ShowAs.description: The status that the calendar event should be for the participants.

Subject.description: The subject or title of the meeting. This field is a short description that gives participants an idea of the meeting's purpose.

TimeZone.description: The timezone in which the meeting is scheduled. Supports Windows Time Zone IDs (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time', 'China Standard Time') or IANA time zones (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Use 'UTC' when StartDateTime/EndDateTime ends with 'Z'.

IsOnlineMeeting.description: Indicates whether the meeting is an online meeting.

IsAllDay.description: Indicates whether the event is an all-day event. When true, StartDateTime and EndDateTime must be midnight (e.g., '2025-11-11T00:00:00' and '2025-11-12T00:00:00').

BodyType.description: The type of the body content. Possible values are text and html.

Placeholders.description: List of placeholders in the message content.

Sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of the event. Maps to Microsoft Graph event sensitivity enum.

ReminderMinutesBeforeStart.description: Number of minutes prior to start when a reminder should fire (0–1440).

AllowNewTimeProposals.description: Whether attendees can propose a new time.

SingleValueExtendedProperties.description: Single value extended properties for the event.

allOf.title: Placeholders require BodyType to be 'html'
allOf.description: When Placeholders array is present and non-empty, BodyType must be set to 'html'.

allOf.title: UTC timezone required when datetime ends with 'Z'
allOf.description: When StartDateTime or EndDateTime ends with 'Z' (indicating UTC), the TimeZone field must be set to 'UTC'.

allOf.title: All-day events require midnight StartDateTime and EndDateTime
allOf.description: When IsAllDay is true, StartDateTime and EndDateTime must be in pure date format at midnight (e.g., '2025-11-11T00:00:00' and '2025-11-12T00:00:00'), with no fractional seconds and no 'Z' suffix.

Placeholder.description: Represents a placeholder in a message that can be of various types (Hyperlink, Attachment, Image, Mention, etc.)
